subject: Conversion stimulus: CedarPoint trial extension & one-time credit
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CedarPoint ask - trial + credit

Team —

Quick context: CedarPoint Health (Avery Collins) is actively evaluating our private deployment for a set of clinical workflows. They started the pilot two weeks ago and have been happy with latency and accuracy on sample prompts. Their legal/procurement timeline is tight — they need a signed addendum and a clear cost tie-in to finalize the pilot-to-paid conversion before EoQ.

Customer ask (via call):
- 30-day trial extension to finish 2 final integrations
- One-time onboarding/consumption credit of $15,000 to offset pilot costs and make the budget work this quarter

Why I think we should do it:
- High likelihood to convert (clinical ISV + willing to purchase Dedicated if pilot proves out)
- Strategic vertical (healthcare) and reference value
- Short runway to close (asks to finalize by Oct 5)

Requesting approvals:
- Karthik: discretionary credit approval for up to $15k? If not, what cap do you want to set?
- Marissa/Finance: can we route a one-time promotional credit and what are accounting flags?
- Monica/CS: confirm scope for extension and success criteria so we can tie the credit to outcomes.

Attaching a short terms doc (draft) with the credit and 30-day extension. If we get greenlights I can push an outbound communication and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: CedarPoint ask - trial + credit

Jasmine —

Appreciate the crisp ask. I’m comfortable approving a one-time $12,500 promotional credit tied to the 30-day extension with two conditions:

1) The credit is valid only if CedarPoint signs the addendum and DocuSign is returned within 10 business days of the outbound send.
2) Monica and Jasmine to document three measurable success criteria (latency < 200ms for the integrated flows, 95% pass rate on key eval prompts, and agreed KPIs for go/no-go) — we use this to gate the larger Dedicated commit.

If CedarPoint absolutely needs $15k to close, escalate to me and I’ll run it up to Sales Ops for an exception — but expect a slightly longer approval window.

Marissa — please confirm whether Finance can record this as a marketing/promotional allowance and any GL codes we must use.

Ben — once you get Marissa’s ok, please send the outbound with the attached terms. Keep the language conditional (sign + success criteria).

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery@cedarpointhealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: CedarPoint: 30-day extension + promotional credit (draft addendum)

Avery —

Great talking earlier. Per our conversation, we’d like to offer CedarPoint Health a 30-day pilot extension and a one-time promotional credit of $12,500 to help close this quarter. This is intended to offset pilot costs and make the project budget-neutral while we finalize procurement.

What this means in practice:
- 30-day extension of the pilot start date from Oct 1 to Oct 31, 2026
- A one-time credit of $12,500 applied to usage/onboarding fees after the signed addendum is returned
- Credit is conditional on: (a) signed addendum delivered via DocuSign within 10 business days of this email, and (b) meeting the three success criteria we discussed (integration stability, API latency targets, and evaluation pass rate).

Attached: draft addendum (CedarPoint_promo_terms_v1.pdf) and the form we’ll send for signature (eSignature_request_cedarpoint.docx). I’ve also linked a short HubSpot record for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

If you’re good with this I’ll send the DocuSign envelope and route the credit for final Finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
Attachments: CedarPoint_promo_terms_v1.pdf (pdf), eSignature_request_cedarpoint.docx (docx)
From: Avery Collins <avery@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cedarpointhealth.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPoint: 30-day extension + promotional credit (draft addendum)

Ben / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for being flexible. The extension and $12.5k credit sound reasonable. A couple of asks from our side before we sign:
- Can the credit be split: $7.5k applied up-front to onboarding fees and $5k applied after successful completion of the evaluation window? Our procurement prefers a portion up-front to keep the implementation team staffed.
- Minor wording tweak: change the success criteria language to reference the attached evaluation matrix (we’ll send our version back with minor edits).

If you can accept the split and the wording change, Procurement will sign the addendum and we’ll return the DocuSign within 48 hours.

Avery Collins
Director, Clinical Integrations | CedarPoint Health
avery@cedarpointhealth.com | (312) 555-0987
